title: Easy Baileys Cheesecake
description: This Baileys cheesecake with a graham cracker crust and Irish cream liqueur filling is a decadent dessert for St. Patrick's Day or any occasion.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Mix together cracker crumbs, 3 tablespoons sugar, and melted butter; press mixture into bottom of 9-inch springform pan with 2 ¾ inch high sides. Bake crust in preheated oven until golden brown, about 8 minutes. Transfer crust to a rack to cool. Maintain oven temperature.

Beat cream cheese, 1 cup sugar, and vanilla in large bowl with an electric mixer until blended. Beat in 1 cup sour cream and Irish cream liqueur. Add eggs one at a time, beating just until combined. Pour filling over crust in pan.
Bake in preheated oven until edges are puffed, and center no longer moves when pan is shaken, about 1 to 1 ½ hours. Transfer cheesecake to a rack, and cool for 10 minutes. Maintain oven temperature.

Mix 1 cup sour cream and 1/4 cup sugar in a small bowl until smooth. Press down edges of cheesecake, and spread mixture on top. Bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes. Transfer cheesecake to rack and cool.
Cover and refrigerate cheesecake for 8 hours to overnight.
